Getting started

From install to your first bill

01

Install the app

Download from Google Play or the App Store. The web app is available in any browser.

02

Sign in with your number

Enter your mobile number and the one-time code. No password to set, nothing to remember.

03

Add your business

Name, type, address, and PAN or VAT if you have them. This takes about two minutes.

04

Write your first bill

Add a product or two and raise an invoice. The ledger, stock and cash update together.

What you need

  • Android 8.0 or later
  • iOS 14 or later
  • Any modern browser for the web app
  • A Nepali mobile number for sign-in

What it costs

The free plan is genuinely free and does not expire. It covers a single business with core billing, the ledger, stock and offline mode — enough for many small shops indefinitely.

Paid plans start with a 30-day trial and are billed through eSewa, Khalti or Fonepay. No card is required to start.

See plans

Bringing your old records

If you are moving from a spreadsheet or another app, we can help. Send us your product and party lists and we will prepare them for import — this is included with Premium and Enterprise, and offered free during setup for smaller businesses.

Ask about migration

Start on the free plan today

There is no trial clock on the free plan and no card to enter. Add your business, write a few bills, and decide later whether you need more.
